display.purpose: Confident native-sans hero; maximum 88px on the homepage.

headline.purpose: Major product and narrative sections; 600 weight and tight balanced lines.

title.purpose: Project names, service names, and supporting panel titles.

body.purpose: Readable project explanations, generally 16–18px within a restrained text measure.

label.purpose: Compact navigation, source notes, facts, and controls.

shadows.name: phone-hero
shadows.purpose: Depth below the homepage product devices.

shadows.name: phone-supporting
shadows.purpose: Soft separation around actual interface captures.

shadows.name: selected-tab

shadows.name: navigation-divider

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Shared CSS product and interaction easing.

motion.name: hero-copy
motion.purpose: Already-visible headline and supporting copy move into place.

motion.name: hero-devices
motion.purpose: Layered real screens settle into the hero.

motion.name: chapter-copy
motion.purpose: Transition into a selected product chapter.

motion.name: chapter-visual
motion.purpose: Product imagery accompanies the selected chapter.

motion.name: scroll-scrub
motion.purpose: Subtle GSAP product separation and contextual-image parallax.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Keep every control and content item accessible without the authored motion.

motion.name: sticky-eligibility
motion.purpose: Use scroll-selected product chapters only when the complete stage fits comfortably.

motion.name: reduced-transparency
motion.purpose: Replace translucent navigation with an opaque white surface.

components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;max-width:300px;min-height:46px;padding:0 6px 0 15px;background:var(--surface,#f5f5f7);border-radius:999px;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);font:400 14px/1.5 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Geist,'Helvetica Neue','Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-search-label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap}.ds-search>svg{color:var(--muted,#6e6e73);flex-shrink:0}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:11px 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;caret-color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#6e6e73);opacity:1}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:0}.ds-search:focus-within{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#1d1d1f);outline-offset:3px}.ds-search button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;flex:0 0 38px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:transparent;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-search button:hover{background:#e8e8ed}.ds-search button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#1d1d1f);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Geist,'Helvetica Neue','Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-filters button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;padding:11px 17px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);font:500 14px/1.4 -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Geist,'Helvetica Neue','Segoe UI',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .22s,color .22s}.ds-filters button:hover{background:var(--surface,#f5f5f7)}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);color:var(--paper,#fff)}.ds-filters button:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-filters button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#1d1d1f);outline-offset:4px}

components.css: .ds-recording{max-width:580px;border-bottom:1px solid #d2d2d7;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Geist,'Helvetica Neue','Segoe UI',sans-serif}.ds-recording summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:54px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;font-weight:500}.ds-recording summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-recording summary svg{transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-recording[open] summary svg{transform:rotate(90deg)}.ds-recording summary:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-recording summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink,#1d1d1f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-recording p{max-width:75ch;margin:0;padding:0 0 21px;color:var(--muted,#6e6e73);font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-recording summary svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: An Apple-inspired presentation adapted to KashCrop’s own work. White and silver surfaces, confident sans-serif headlines, and actual product captures create a familiar visual rhythm. Product motion adds scale and depth while navigation and controls remain direct. The original KashCrop logo and factual product records remain authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Native system sans with locally hosted Geist fallback
One white/silver visual system across routes
Actual interfaces presented at a readable scale
Product choreography with a complete reduced-motion experience
Optional manually controlled recordings with source context

rules.name: The Neutral Frame Rule
rules.body: Product colors belong to actual imagery and selected presentation stages; the surrounding website stays neutral.

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings and prose use the same sans family. The superseded Fraunces pairing is not visual authority.

rules.name: The Product Depth Rule
rules.body: Spend depth on presented software and active overlays. Keep routine content panels calm.

dos: Do retain the KashCrop logo, original wording, and factual project content.
Do preserve readable screen inspection, URL behavior, and keyboard focus.
Do make product motion ambitious while retaining a complete static experience.
Do keep source notes and sample-data context with historical demonstrations.
Do place source captions below artwork with a clear gap so they remain separate from the product image.
donts: Don't restore the superseded serif/red-room visual system.
Don't fabricate screenshots, performance figures, adoption metrics, or validation claims.
Don't hide necessary content behind animation.
Don't autoplay optional recordings or leave them playing when closed.
